caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden armchair with a high, rectangular backrest that has a recessed central panel. The chair is shown in three-quarter perspective, slightly turned to the viewer's left. It features gently curving armrests that extend forward and are supported by vertical, lathe-turned arm supports. The seat appears to be cushioned with an upholstered surface in a muted, slightly worn beige or tan color. The legs of the chair are also lathe-turned and are connected by stretchers on all four sides; the stretchers are rectangular and positioned close to the ground, providing additional support. The wood throughout is illustrated in shades of medium to dark brown, with visible graining detail. The background is a plain, untextured light beige or off-white color, with no other objects or scenery present. Near the bottom left of the chair, there is a small, handwritten label with the words "Frankes" and "Leuten."
title: Pa. German Chair
